name: What types of stucco cracks are considered serious?
description: Cracks wider than 1/8 inch, horizontal cracks, stair-step cracks, or those with water leakage are serious and need professional assessment.

mainEntity.name: What types of stucco cracks are considered serious?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cracks that are wider than 1/8 inch, run horizontally across a wall, appear in a stair-step pattern in masonry, or show evidence of active water leakage are generally considered serious. These types of cracks can indicate significant structural movement, foundation problems, or water penetration issues that require immediate professional attention to prevent extensive damage to your home.
